metadata.title: KP01 · Decide what to preserve
metadata.description: Reasoning-led 2.3.1; editable native teaching deck; global manual mode; no narration.

choose-title.name: choose-title
choose-title.text: Select a column, or calculate a new feature?

choose-context.name: choose-context
choose-context.text: The readings share a scale; $D$ counts input coordinates and $q$ counts output coordinates.

choose-source.name: choose-source
choose-source.text: PR · KP01 · 1/10  |  Handout §1,§2  |  Manual Next / Prev

choose-bubble.name: choose-bubble
choose-bubble.text: Follow each arrow: is the output an original reading or a calculated quantity?

observations-title.name: observations-title
observations-title.text: Locate the differences in four observations

observations-context.name: observations-context
observations-context.text: Added, constructed observations. A/B labels support interpretation and are not inputs to feature calculations.

observations-source.name: observations-source
observations-source.text: PR · KP01 · 2/10  |  Handout §3  |  Manual Next / Prev

observations-bubble.name: observations-bubble
observations-bubble.text: Read each pair of coordinates, compare A with B, and cite positions in the diagram.

collapse-title.name: collapse-title
collapse-title.text: Which observations do mean and contrast merge?

collapse-context.name: collapse-context
collapse-context.text: $m$ is the mean; $r$ is second minus first. R1–R4 identify matrix rows; one marker represents coincident observations.

collapse-source.name: collapse-source
collapse-source.text: PR · KP01 · 3/10  |  Handout §3,§5  |  Manual Next / Prev

collapse-bubble.name: collapse-bubble
collapse-bubble.text: Calculate the features, then use coincident markers to check which labels remain distinguishable.

invert-title.name: invert-title
invert-title.text: Can two generated features recover the readings?

invert-context.name: invert-context
invert-context.text: Retain both $m$ and $r$. Input and output each still have two coordinates.

invert-source.name: invert-source
invert-source.text: PR · KP01 · 4/10  |  Handout §4,§8  |  Manual Next / Prev

invert-bubble.name: invert-bubble
invert-bubble.text: Combine the equations to solve for the readings and check uniqueness.

reconstruct-title.name: reconstruct-title
reconstruct-title.text: How can mean-only reconstruction be checked?

reconstruct-source.name: reconstruct-source
reconstruct-source.text: PR · KP01 · 5/10  |  Handout §4  |  Manual Next / Prev

reconstruct-bubble.name: reconstruct-bubble
reconstruct-bubble.text: Use the original and reconstructed observations to verify each squared residual.

task-context.name: task-context
task-context.text: Compare compression, recognition, and retrieval; no real-data performance experiment is supplied.

task-source.name: task-source
task-source.text: PR · KP01 · 6/10  |  Handout §5  |  Manual Next / Prev

task-bubble.name: task-bubble
task-bubble.text: Match each task on the left with the relationship that actually needs evaluation.

protocol-title.name: protocol-title
protocol-title.text: How should unseen observations be evaluated?

protocol-context.name: protocol-context
protocol-context.text: Let $f$ be the representation, $h$ the classifier, $x$ an input, and $y$ its label. Trace fitting and testing here; candidate selection follows.

protocol-source.name: protocol-source
protocol-source.text: PR · KP01 · 7/10  |  Handout §7  |  Manual Next / Prev

protocol-bubble.name: protocol-bubble
protocol-bubble.text: Trace which observations fit $f,h$ and which participate only in final evaluation.

selection-protocol-title.name: selection-protocol-title
selection-protocol-title.text: Who selects settings, and who evaluates the final choice?

selection-protocol-context.name: selection-protocol-context
selection-protocol-context.text: $k$ indexes candidate settings; $f_k,h_k$ denote a representation and model. Training, validation, and test observations are separate.

selection-protocol-source.name: selection-protocol-source
selection-protocol-source.text: PR · KP01 · 8/10  |  Handout §7  |  Manual Next / Prev

selection-protocol-bubble.name: selection-protocol-bubble
selection-protocol-bubble.text: Trace fitted candidates, selection evidence, and the frozen model. Which results influence selection?

roadmap-title.name: roadmap-title
roadmap-title.text: Which question does each later method answer?

roadmap-context.name: roadmap-context
roadmap-context.text: Arrows indicate suggested reading links. The manifold view branches to kernel and graph approaches, developed in later units.

roadmap-source.name: roadmap-source
roadmap-source.text: PR · KP01 · 9/10  |  Handout §6  |  Manual Next / Prev

roadmap-bubble.name: roadmap-bubble
roadmap-bubble.text: Trace the preservation goals; later units implement each branch.

roadmap-nmf.text:

new-reading-title.text: A new observation: what information remains?

new-reading-source.name: new-reading-source

new-reading-bubble.name: new-reading-bubble
new-reading-bubble.text: Compute and invert $m,r$. Is the mean alone unique? Write your reasoning before pressing Next.
